task.title: Establish Workbook performance benchmark harness and baseline
task.description: Build a repeatable performance harness using 500 active tasks with 20 historical operations each. Capture the pre-optimization baseline for local mutations, warm API and cold CLI paths, rapid bursts, Git process counts, loose and packed refs, operation/state object growth, projection rebuild and refresh, incremental and full history validation, local bare-remote sync, and SHA-1/SHA-256 repositories when supported. This task establishes the harness and baseline only; it does not tune repeatedly until targets are met.
